leagues.name: Alfa-Bank Russian Premier League
notes: 2026-27 season ran from 24 July 2026 to 29 May 2027, with a winter break after 7 December 2026 until 26 February 2027.
Named 'Alfa-Bank Russian Premier League' for sponsorship reasons since July 2026 (title sponsor Alfa-Bank).
Russian clubs have been suspended from FIFA and UEFA competitions since February 2022 following the invasion of Ukraine.
The official premierliga.ru site is behind a Yandex anti-bot CAPTCHA, so club and sponsor facts rely on club announcements and press coverage.

unsourced: Front-of-shirt placements for most clubs follow each club's own sponsors/partners page (general sponsor or first-listed partner), not a 2026-27 kit launch or match photo; treat placements as provisional.
Zenit sleeve/back partners (Winline, Aeroflot, MegaFon, Gazprom Neft, Gazprombank, SOGAZ) from fc-zenit.ru/biz/partners/ — shirt placements not confirmed.
CSKA sleeve/back sponsors per Wikipedia's 2026-27 kit table include Chestny Znak; Chestny Znak is confirmed as a CSKA 'strategic partner' on pfc-cska.com but its shirt placement is not confirmed.
Akhmat Grozny: Wikipedia's kit table lists 'Akhmat Foundation' as shirt sponsor; the club partners page lists Фонд Ахмат (fondkadyrova.net) as a partner but does not state shirt placement.
Fakel Voronezh: Wikipedia's kit table lists Ekoniva as shirt sponsor; Ekoniva is confirmed as a club partner on fakelfc.ru/partners but without a stated tier or shirt placement.

Orenburg: Wikipedia's kit table lists EcoGas as shirt sponsor; EcoGas could not be confirmed anywhere on fcorenburg.ru (the Gazprom dobycha Orenburg general-sponsor block is commented out in the page markup).

Krasnodar: Constell Group is the club's 'general partner' per fckrasnodar.ru, but Wikipedia's kit table says the shirt sponsor is Winline and the kit maker is self-branded; the relationship between the two is not documented.
Dynamo Moscow sleeve/back sponsor Betcity is confirmed in the fcdynamo.ru footer but its shirt placement is not confirmed.

Kit makers per Wikipedia's 2026-27 table (Jogel: Akhmat, Rostov, Spartak, Zenit; Italsport: Akron, Lokomotiv; Jako: Baltika; PRIMERA: CSKA, Orenburg; Bosco: Dynamo Moscow; Kelme: Fakel, Krylia Sovetov) could not be verified against club pages and are not recorded as kit sponsors.
